options.interpretation: This directly answers the requested year-by-year count: the annual totals range from 101 in 2020 to 176 in 2013, with the full sequence shown in the chart and values file. Summing the pedestrian-fatality field across crashes in each calendar year is a direct count of the reported pedestrian deaths, with no population or crash-count denominator imposed; it does not address rates, causes, or comparisons with other road-user deaths.
